description: This file is a complete HTML page that implements a web-based database visualizer interface, including styling, layout, and embedded JavaScript for data fetching, dynamic content rendering, and user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-fetching the data and updating the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays the tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays the data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content based on the value type, including expandable objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expansion of cell content to view full data.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message in a specified element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in a specified element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Displays a message indicating no data is available.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Highlights the currently selected database or table.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Performs fetch requests to the server APIs and returns the parsed JSON data.
